name: The Red Messenger
label: Quest
description: Executor Arren tasks newly risen Forsaken with intercepting a courier dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery to the crusade camp outside Deathknell.…
intro: Executor Arren tasks newly risen Forsaken with intercepting a courier dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery to the crusade camp outside Deathknell. Intercepting the messenger secures critical intelligence on local Scarlet movements before the zealots can solidify their presence in the valley. This mission marks one of the earliest offensive operations undertaken to secure the Forsaken's fledgling sanctuary.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!
You're the most qualified person I have to send, friend. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

Some news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.
